scope: Independent EXR decoding, finiteness, ranges, hashes, normal unit lengths, and manifest sampling audit. Shadow/reflection per-piece identity and complete absence are NOT_VALIDATED. Review PNGs use one fixed physical-radiance exposure for every probe face and snapshot; originals are unchanged.

captures.reflection: Actual HDProbe.realtimeTexture; 128 px; mode=EveryFrame; timeSlicing=False; texture updateCount=5; position=(0.00, 1.05, 0.00)

pixelAudit.scope: Actual HDRP depth/normal readback versus current uploaded mesh ray intersections at sampled interior/near-edge pixels. Historical Empty silhouettes test selected stale-depth pixels. Other scene occluders are classified separately. A disagreement within 1/128 pixel of a projected triangle edge is NOT_VALIDATED_RASTER_BOUNDARY, never a passing normal/depth match; it bounds subpixel raster coverage ambiguity. This does not validate every pixel, final color, shadows, reflections, or temporal history.
pixelAudit.isolatedReadbackDepthMutation: PASS_DETECTED: FAIL_DEPTH_BEHIND_CURRENT_MESH; isolated CPU mutation of one actual GPU-readback depth pixel; no GPU render fault was injected; original pixels and baseline probes were preserved
